planets.name: K2-117 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-117 with a 5.44-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: K2-117 c was found in 2017 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-117. Its orbit and size follow Livingston et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.
